launch

shot 01-launch

shot 02-menu-with-shop
sh input tap 1032 1521; sleep 5; dumpsys activity activities | grep -q 'ResumedActivity.*ShopActivity' || { input tap 1032 1441; sleep 5; }; dumpsys activity activities | grep -q 'ResumedActivity.*ShopActivity' || { input tap 1032 1482; sleep 5; }; dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'topResumedActivity'
wait 6
shot 03-shop
tap (?i)^BUY .*2\.99$

wait 2
